# dsh-plugin-live-diff

Live streaming diffs for DSH file edits — a diff
that **grows while the model is still emitting the

call**, instead of appearing all
at once when the tool call settles. Since 0.2.0 the same stream is

also painted
**behind the whole app** as a frosted-glass window backdrop.

## The problem

DSH already ships a diff card, and it already accumulates the streaming data — the
host does `argsRa

w: base.argsRaw + chunk.argumentsDelta` for exactly this reason.
What it lacks is a reader that tole
rates a **half-arrived** argument string:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

While a call streams, `argsRaw` is a truncated JSON document, so the parse fails and
the card stays

empty until the final token lands. This plugin supplies the tolerant
reader, and a surface to put th

the final token lands. This plugin supplies the tolerant
reader, and a surface to put the result on.
## What it does

- **Floating panel** (`Live Diffs`) that patches the diff in place as characters
arrive. Width is dr

aggable from its left edge and remembered across reloads.
- **Chat transcript card** for `edit` / `w

rite`, rendered through DSH's own
`DiffBlock` primitive so it matches the shell's diff cards by cons

truction.
- **Tolerant reader** over partial JSON: a field whose value string is still open
comes ba

ck usable-but-incomplete instead of `null`.
- **Partial syntax colouring** with per-language profile

s (Python, JS/TS, JSON,
YAML, shell, Markdown).
- The panel keeps the newest line in view while stre

aming, and **stays on screen
after the edit finishes** rather than blanking the moment `entries` emp

ties.
- **A finished edit is not re-rendered row by row** — the DOM is patched
incrementally, so a l
ine's fade-in plays once instead of restarting on every poll.
## The window backdrop

The same reading is painted behind the entire app. The shell's large opaque
surfaces are **measured,

not matched by class name** (viewport area + computed
background): surfaces covering ≥85% of the wi

ndow are cleared so the backdrop can
show through, and opaque panels ≥0.1% become frosted glass. Nes

ted surfaces are
skipped once an ancestor is glassed — two stacked translucent layers turn
"frosted"

re
skipped once an ancestor is glassed — two stacked translucent layers turn
"frosted" into "milky".

- **Liquid glass**: in browsers that accept it, `backdrop-filter: url(#dshld-lg-lens)`
refracts the

diff behind big panels through an SVG displacement filter; elsewhere
it degrades to plain blur.
- **

Pointer light**: a soft sheen follows the cursor across the glass; its strength
and radius are tunab

le.
- **White foregrounds**: over glass the shell's grey text loses contrast, so text is
lifted to w

hite by default — and its opacity is a slider.
- **Titlebar untouched**: the window's titlebar keeps

the stock look; only the app
area becomes glass.
- **Live-tunable**: the backdrop stylesheet is *se

rved* from disk rather than baked
into the bundle, and the browser re-fetches it every 1.5 s. Edits

to `style.css`
land in about a second, with no restart and no rebuild.
### Appearance tuner

A round button at the bottom-right corner opens a 264 px panel with **9 sliders and
2 switches** (中文

2 switches** (中文界面):
| Control | Range | What it changes |

| 面板不透明度 | 0.05 – 0.9 | one opacity for every glass band |
| 玻璃模糊 | 0 – 24 px | backdrop blur radius

|
| 折射强度 | 0 – 40 | liquid-glass displacement scale |
| 高光强度 | 0 – 1 | pointer-light sheen opacity

|
| 光斑大小 | 80 – 900 px | sheen radius |
| 文字不透明度 | 0.3 – 1 | foreground text alpha (white-text mode)

|
| 代码层亮度 | 0.2 – 1 | opacity of the diff painted behind the app |
| 代码字号 | 12 – 28 px | size of th

at backdrop code |
| 背景压暗 | 0 – 1 | veil over the backdrop |
| 界面文字转白色 | on/off | lift every foregro

und to white |
| 液态玻璃（折射） | on/off | use the SVG refraction filter |

Values persist in `localStorage` (`dshld.tuner.v2`); the panel's reset button puts
every control bac

`localStorage` (`dshld.tuner.v2`); the panel's reset button puts
every control back to its default.
## Requirements

Built and verified against **DSH `0.1.5-rc.1`** and the DSH desktop app on
**`0.2.1-rc.5`**, Windows

against **DSH `0.1.5-rc.1`** and the DSH desktop app on
**`0.2.1-rc.5`**, Windows (`cordis` 4.0.2).

This plugin talks to DSH through its **internal** client surfaces, not a published
extension API. No
thing here is versioned or guaranteed:
| What it relies on | Used for |
| `ctx.sessions` client service | reading the session event window — the only source carrying stream

ing `tool-call-delta` chunks |
| `ctx.slots` / `ctx.sidebarRightTabs` | registering the transcript c

ard and the sidebar tab type |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` (`DiffBlock`) | the chat tr

anscript card |
| `ctx.webServer` + `ctx.clientModules` | the host-side `/live-diff-diag` diagnostic

route and the served stylesheet |
| keyed `tool.call.toolview` entries for `edit` / `write` | **rep
lacing** the shipped `FileMutationRow` for those two tools |

That last row is the sharpest edge: a keyed registration replaces the shipped row,
so this plugin de

liberately overrides a component DSH ships. A DSH upgrade that
renames the tool keys, changes the `t

oolview` contract, or restructures the session
event window will break it — most likely by showing a

n empty panel rather than by
raising an error.

If you are on a different DSH build, try it and read the diagnostics (below); the
panel reports what
it can and cannot see rather than failing silently.
